headline: Frontier Ledger Finds Six Sectors in Ferment
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger still points to Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf as the chief unsettled fronts, while Callahan’s Passage has emerged as another sector worth watching. Weathered Expanse recorded 41 ownership events in 24 hours, including five in the latest six-hour watch; its nine strategic bases stand six Warden to three Colonial, with casualties accelerating on both sides. Stlican Shelf logged 30 daily events and eight in six hours, leaving four Warden bases against five Colonial. Deadlands remains fiercely contested at 16 events, three in six hours, with both casualty streams accelerating and the ledger split three Warden to eight Colonial. Godcrofts posted 20 events, three during the latest two-hour watch, and now stands seven Warden to two Colonial. Callahan’s Passage recorded 11 events, chiefly around The Latch and The Procession, though none appeared in the latest six-hour window. Fisherman’s Row remains active in the broader ledger with 22 daily events, but its latest event is older and its immediate watch is quiet; eight bases are Warden-held against one Colonial. Most other sectors show no recent strategic turnover.
